info.title: Tredjekort address report API
info.description: Read map data and Danish or English prose by Danish access address. Expected with-project noise uses verified address/dwelling model values, then the original-scenario contour band. Both describe the official 2021 model forecasting 2040, including selected surrounding roads, not isolated motorway noise or the current 2035 design. Legacy fields are preserved; current measurements, audibility and compliance are unavailable.

get.summary: Map data and prose for a Danish access address
get.description: Provide exactly one of address or id. No key is required. Text search is non-fuzzy; multiple matches return 409 with candidates. GET and OPTIONS support cross-origin requests. Responses are not cached. Dataset facts are a reviewed snapshot, while DAWA address lookup is live.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Street, house number and postcode, without floor or door. Mutually exclusive with id. No control characters or wildcards.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: DAWA access-address UUID, for example from /api/addresses autocomplete or a 409 response. Mutually exclusive with address.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language for description, noise reason and limitations. Original map properties and bilingual project data retain their source language.

409.description: Ambiguous search: choose a candidate and repeat with its id

502.description: Address service unavailable or invalid upstream response

504.description: Address lookup exceeded the eight-second timeout

204.description: Empty response. Allowed methods: GET, OPTIONS; allowed origin: *.

InvalidQuery.description: Missing, duplicate, unknown or invalid query parameter

municipalityCode.description: DAWA municipality code used for strict historical receiver matching.

properties.description: Original map metadata including source, confidence, notes and available geometry-specific facts. All geometry is approximate regardless of legacy confidence labels.

upperDb.description: Null for the source top category labelled 78 dB, whose upper bound is not specified.

sourceGeometryIssueFeatureIds.description: Source features with known invalid polygon components whose bounding boxes contain the address. No definitive band is given there; valid components remain queryable elsewhere.

belowMappedThreshold.description: An absent polygon never establishes noise below the mapped threshold.

ExpectedWithProject.description: Original with-project scenario only. Exact DAWA municipality/road/house matching plus a 50m coordinate guard selects historical dwelling records; every matched row must have a usable original value. Otherwise use only the original contour, never reference or variant. Historical modeled output is not measurement accuracy or the motorway-only contribution.

valueDb.description: Original historical modeled facade/dwelling value, preserving source decimals, when all matched records have one identical value. Null for a multi-value range or contour fallback. Display with one decimal place; source precision is not measured accuracy.

receiverRange.description: Always present for either point_* status, including one/equal values. Covers all matched dwelling records without choosing a floor.

sourceRecordId.description: Stable numeric id in the source; WFS feature ids can change.

sourceFloor.description: Raw source floor code, not converted to DAWA floor labels.

receiverDataStatus.description: Incomplete groups retain source rows with null unknown values but never produce a falsely complete receiver range. Raw zero sentinels are treated as unknown.

band.description: Original-scenario contour fallback only. Never a midpoint or reference/variant substitute; null for receiver results and uncertain/unmapped contours.

exactDb.description: An exact actual/measured address noise value is unsupported. valueDb denotes historical modeled output only.

motorwayOnlyDb.description: The model includes the motorway and selected surrounding roads; their contributions cannot be separated from this dataset.

description.description: Danish/English estimate, provenance and limitations. Scalar/range model output is rounded to one decimal only in prose.

withinMappedCorridor.description: True within 2 km of the mapped alignment. This is a proximity filter, not an impact boundary.

nearestOfficialDesign.description: Distance to the official 2025 design centreline network, including ramps and local roads. Contains distanceMeters rounded to 10m, featureId, original properties and source metadata; the large geometry is omitted.

nearestJunction.description: Original junction metadata plus distanceMeters rounded to 10 m. The nearest junction may be outside the nearby radius.

nearbyNoiseScreens.description: Recorded sections within 2 km. Proximity does not establish barrier effectiveness. Group lengths must not be double-counted.

landRequirements.description: Point lookup against permanent and temporary official 2025 planning areas. This does not establish property boundaries or expropriation.

sourceGeometryIssues.description: Known invalid source polygon components whose bounding boxes contain the address.

projectInformation.description: Same reviewed project-information dataset as the web app: project, facts, timeline, documents, updates and limitations, with bilingual text and source URLs.
